title: SWE session sync v2
description: Generated by `python3 -m swe.remote.schema --write` from src/swe/remote/adapters/events.py. Do not edit by hand.

LiveMessage.description: A message still being written: its id and the full text so far.

Event.description: One v2 event. `seq` above 0 is its place in the session's journal; 0 marks one the hub made for the stream, which is not journaled and never moves a cursor. message.delta has none.

Row.description: The session's row, as GET /v1/sessions lists it (docs/remote-control.md).

Checkpoint.description: One checkpoint.created, with the seq, time and turn of its event.

Snapshot.description: Everything a client needs to draw one session from nothing, true at `head`. The body of GET /v1/sessions/{id}/snapshot and the data of a session.snapshot frame.

Frame.description: Anything a v=2 session stream sends.

CommandLookup.description: GET /v1/sessions/{id}/commands/{command_id}: one stored command, when /v1/status lists command_lookup. `receipt` is the stored status; `result` is there once the command finished. 404 unknown_command when the hub does not hold the id for the session.
